description: This file defines an enumeration 'OutputFormat' that specifies different output formats ('txt' and 'srt') for transcripts, including methods for format-specific text generation and handling of audio time ranges.

methods.name: needsAudioTimeRange
methods.description: Returns whether the format requires audio time ranges (true for 'srt', false for 'txt').

methods.name: text(for:maxLength:)
methods.description: Generates formatted text based on the output format, with special handling for 'srt' format including time range formatting and sentence extraction.
